subject: EOQ check-in: BlueBridge AI pilot timeline & approval route
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bluebridge.ai>, Elena Kuznetsova <elena@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: BlueBridge AI — pilot scope & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we're aligned on timing as we head into the quarter close:

- Value and scope we discussed: inference for recommendation reranking (50–200 qps steady, spiky during batch runs), support for 1M embeddings/month, and a lightweight logging/audit retention plan.
- Success metrics: 15% CTR uplift on rerank experiments, inference p99 < 150ms for 256 tokens.
- Proposed pilot: 6-week hosted pilot (dedicated burst pool) to validate latencies and cost profile, with an optional 30-day extended eval.
- Items we need from you: procurement owner, target approval date, and any compliance checklist items (SOC2/PDP) to include in SOW.

I've attached the rwd-pilot-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal stub) and shared the call recording here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-recording.

Can you confirm: who owns the budget approval and whether BlueBridge is still aiming to decide before year-end? If timing slipped, are you open to a lightweight pilot that starts immediately on our hosted tier while procurement finalizes the reserved plan?

Thanks — happy to set a 15-minute follow-up if helpful.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bluebridge.ai>

Cc: Elena Kuznetsova <elena@bluebridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BlueBridge AI — pilot scope & next steps

Evelyn — thanks for the follow. Short update from our side: budget conversation landed with the CFO this morning and they pushed the larger procurement into the January budgeting cycle. That means we likely won't have a signed reserved commit by 12/31.

That said, we'd like to keep momentum. Two asks: 1) can you offer a low-friction hosted pilot with capped spend so we can validate performance before the budget window? 2) can your team provide a short SOW that procurement can review (they like minimal legal / PO-friendly SOWs)?

Procurement lead: Nina Patel (nina.p@bluebridge.ai) — please cc her on contractual/PO threads.

Also, Elena and I prefer to avoid any long lock-in before procurement completes approval. If you have a pilot pricing option (short term credits or trial caps) that'd be ideal.

Appreciate it — Sanjay
Director of ML Engineering
BlueBridge AI

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bluebridge.ai>, Nina Patel <nina.p@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BlueBridge AI — pilot scope & next steps

Great — thanks for the clarity, Sanjay, and hi Nina. We're flexible and want to keep this low-friction so you can validate results before the January budget cycle. Two options from our side:

Option A — Immediate hosted pilot (recommended now):
- 2-week proof-of-value on hosted API with a hard spend cap ($5,000) and a 30% trial credit applied to final invoice if you convert to a reserved deal in Jan.
- Limited to the inference workloads discussed (up to 200 qps).
- No long-term commitment; month-to-month billing if you continue.

Option B — Hold and start in January:
- We'll prepare a concise, PO-friendly SOW and an estimated reserved cost profile so procurement has what they need for the budgeting window.

I attached a short SOW draft (rwd-pp-sow-short.pdf) that skews PO-friendly and strips down legalese. Marissa will own contract coordination and will reach out with a redline-friendly version. Vivek will supply the quick cost/latency sketch by EOD.

If Option A works, we can spin up access within 48 hours and lock the spend cap in our billing console. Thoughts?

— Evelyn

Hi Nina / Sanjay — Marissa here (handling SOW & procurement path). Thanks, Evelyn — I’ll carve the short SOW into a PO-friendly version and circulate an editable doc in the next few hours.

Nina — if you have a preferred PO template or standard purchase terms, please share and I’ll align the SOW to that. If you want to go the immediate pilot route, we can lock the $5k spend cap and issue an invoice under trial credit terms — no signatures required for the pilot access.

Looping Vivek in for the technical sketch and to set an onboarding jitter/kv-cache expectation for the pilot.
